description: Vision model for an image at a public URL: get a detailed description including any visible text, or pass a question to ask something specific about the image. Accepts PNG, JPEG, WebP and GIF up to 3 MB. Use for alt text, OCR-style reading of screenshots, chart reading and content checks. Price $0.01/call via x402 USDC or a card key (/credits); failed calls free. Reads or computes only; not marked read-only because each call is charged.

question.description: Optional question about the image (max 300 characters); default is a detailed description

url.description: Absolute http(s) URL of a PNG, JPEG, WebP or GIF image (max 3 MB)

name: describe
title: Describe or question an image
